user.title: Connect QuickBooks Time
user.description: Paste an API access token. In QuickBooks Time go to Feature Add-ons → Manage Add-ons → API → Install, then Add a new application and copy its Access Token. The token should belong to an admin so Home Assistant can clock in every employee.

reauth_confirm.title: QuickBooks Time token expired
reauth_confirm.description: QuickBooks Time rejected the saved token. Paste a new access token.

error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This QuickBooks Time account is already connected.

api.title: API connection
api.description:
Connected to **{account}** with the token ending in **{token_end}**.

To change it, paste a new access token below. Create one in QuickBooks Time: Feature Add-ons → Manage Add-ons → API → Add a new application, then copy its Access Token. It must belong to an admin of the same company.

photos.title: Employee photos
photos.description: Pick an employee and upload the photo shown on the kiosk after they type their PIN. Without one, their QuickBooks Time profile picture is used. Square photos look best.

genders.title: Male / female
genders.description: Used for the placeholder picture on the dashboard when an employee has no photo.

pins.title: Employee PINs
pins.description: Give each office employee a unique 4-digit PIN for the dashboard keypad. Leave blank for anyone who shouldn't use the keypad.

error.no_photo: Choose a photo to upload, or tick Remove.
error.bad_image: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant log.
error.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different QuickBooks Time company. Add that company as a new integration instead.

abort.not_loaded: The integration isn't loaded. Fix the connection first.
